name: Koldunic Sorcery (Way of Sorrow) — Intermediate — The Misfortune of Chernogolov

system.description:
With a declamation that a person is doomed or destined to fail, the koldun summons the attention of Chernogolov, the silver-mustached god of misfortune, to fall upon her victim. Under his unlucky gaze, the target is hindered in everything he attempts, and any failure he suffers becomes spectacular. As with all Way of Sorrow powers, a botch turns the effect back upon the koldun as if the victim had scored five successes.

System: The koldun's player spends a Willpower point and rolls Manipulation + Koldunism (difficulty equal to the victim's Willpower). For one turn per success, the target automatically loses two successes on every roll he attempts. Botches suffered under the Misfortune of Chernogolov should be especially disastrous.

MET System: Call down the Misfortune of Chernogolov with an appropriately doom-saying phrase and make your Way of Sorrow challenge (Social versus Willpower, Koldunism for retests). If you win, your opponent immediately suffers a two-Trait penalty to initiating and resolving any challenge for the duration — he must risk at least three Traits just to enter a challenge, and loses any additional Trait risked on a failed challenge. This penalty is cumulative with injury or other penalties already afflicting the victim.
system.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
